21138.new_name: Nightclub Leather Collar and Chain Set
21138.desc:
A nightclub-styled collar and chain set in leather, three set colorways - black, pink, white - with printed measurements: collar length 46 cm, adjustable chain 115 cm. The chain length is the story here, long enough for real lead distance.

The collar closes with the standard buckle hardware, and the chain clips to the ring per the pictures. Nightclub styling means the finish holds up under light rigs and flash.

  • Material: leather
  • Item type: collar with chain
  • Style: nightclub
  • Color: set black, pink, or white
  • Fit: collar 46 cm, chain 115 cm adjustable

Printed lengths, three sets. The longest-chain option in the collar category for outfits that want the full leash line.
21138.short: Nightclub leather collar with 115 cm adjustable chain in three set colors, collar 46 cm.
21138.tkd_title: Nightclub Collar and Chain Set, 3 Colors | RoseToys

21139.desc:
A stretch leg garter with a love-bow accent, in black, pink, or white. The elastic band sits at the thigh and holds through an evening without pinching, which is the whole engineering requirement of the format.

The bow is the finishing detail the category is named for - a soft romantic accent against lingerie or bare skin. Three shades cover the standard outfit palettes.

  • Item type: stretch leg garter
  • Decoration: love bow
  • Color: black, pink, or white
  • Fit: one size, stretch band

One size with real stretch. The accessory that upgrades a lingerie set for the price of a coffee.
21139.short: Stretch leg garter with love-bow accent in black, pink or white, one-size elastic band.
21139.tkd_title: Love Bow Stretch Leg Garter, 3 Colors | RoseToys
21139.tkd_desc: Stretch leg garter with love-bow detail in black, pink or white. One-size elastic band, the finishing accessory for any lingerie set.

21167.desc:
A punk-cut leather collar with a heart centerpiece, in black, pink, or red. The heart softens the hardware framing - this is the collision the design lives on.

Leather construction in the standard collar build, three colorways from stark to warm. It pairs with punk and gothic outfits as readily as with intimate occasions, which is the versatility claim and the honest one.

  • Item type: collar
  • Material: leather
  • Style: punk, heart centerpiece
  • Color: black, pink, or red
  • Fit: one size, buckle closure

Three shades, one silhouette. The collar that bridges the costume drawer and the lingerie drawer.
21167.short: Punk leather collar with heart centerpiece in black, pink or red, one-size buckle closure.
21167.tkd_title: Punk Leather Heart Collar, 3 Colors | RoseToys
21167.tkd_desc: Leather punk collar with heart centerpiece in black, pink or red. One size with buckle closure, bridges costume and lingerie wardrobes.

21168.desc:
A skeleton-heart collar in leather with metal chain, white, black, or pink, printed measurements: collar length 45 cm, chain 110 cm. The openwork heart - the skeleton cut - is the focal piece.

The chain adds the length option the plain collars skip, and the two-piece set arrives matched. Openwork detailing reads at conversation distance, which is where collars are judged.

  • Material: leather with metal chain
  • Item type: collar with chain
  • Style: skeleton heart openwork
  • Color: white, black, or pink
  • Fit: collar 45 cm, chain 110 cm

Printed lengths, three colorways, two combos. The gothic-leaning pick in the chained-collar format.
21168.short: Skeleton-heart leather collar with 110 cm chain in three colors, openwork design, collar 45 cm.

21176.desc:
A leather leg garter with a heart accent in black, built on the same base construction as the collar line. The leather version of the garter runs firmer than the elastic formats - it holds its shape rather than stretching into it.

The heart carries the design; the band does the work. Wear it solo or stacked with the chain collars from the same category.

  • Material: leather
  • Item type: leg garter
  • Style: heart
  • Color: black
  • Fit: 40-50 cm adjustment range

The 40-50 cm range suits thigh placement on most frames. The leather garter for outfits where elastic reads too soft.
21176.short: Black leather leg garter with heart accent, 40-50 cm adjustment, structured band.
21176.tkd_title: Heart Leather Leg Garter, Black | RoseToys
21176.tkd_desc: Black leather leg garter with heart accent, 40-50 cm adjustment range. Structured band for thigh wear, pairs with the collar line.

Set packaging and a single colorway keep the decision simple. The collar slips on and holds its look without adjustment fiddling through the evening.

  • Item type: collar set
  • Color: black
  • Style: love heart theme
  • Fit: one size, quick slip-on

One set, one color. The entry-level pick for couples adding a first collar to the drawer.

21194.tkd_desc: Black love collar set with heart detailing, slip-on one-size fit. Pairs with lingerie and bedroom outfits, entry-level couples pick.

The bow-and-bell combination suits cosplay outfits and intimate occasions equally, which is the dual life of most pieces in this category. Two colorways cover the sweet and the sleek.

  • Color: black or white
  • Fit: one size

Pick the shade to match the headband. The finishing piece for cat and maid costumes that arrived without their neck detail.

21198.tkd_title: Cute Bow Bell Neck Ring, 2 Colors | RoseToys
21198.tkd_desc: Neck ring with bow and soft-jingle bell in black or white, lightweight one-size build. Finishing piece for cosplay and intimate looks.

Two styles and two colors make four combinations, at a price that treats the choice as low-stakes. The soft lace edge is what separates this from the leather blackout versions.

  • Item type: eye patch
  • Material: sheer lace
  • Styles: 3039 and 3040, different shapes
  • Color: black or white

Pick style and color at order. The anticipation accessory - mystery at conversational distance, transparent up close.
21199.short: Sheer lace eye patch in two styles and black or white, gentle fit, soft lace edge.
21199.tkd_title: Sheer Lace Eye Patch, 2 Styles | RoseToys
21199.tkd_desc: Sheer lace eye patch in styles 3039 and 3040, black or white. Gentle fit with soft lace edge, obscures without fully blocking.
